text:
maria: FYI - SaturnAI wants a Dedicated commit for their POC. Asking for 8x A100 baseline + ability to burst up to 4x H100 for load tests. 12-month commit. They requested a 25% list discount. Need deal-desk advise asap.

dan: Do we have precedent for mixed A100+H100 pools with burst in a single commit? Any pricing model we should reuse?@finance @deal-desk

zoe: We support mixed pools, but burst to H100 is treated as a higher-cost path. Typical approach: baseline reserve priced by baseline GPU type, burst billed as a multiplier or separate hourly rate. Also recommend locking burst cap for first 90 days.

ajay: 25% is outside standard ranges for 12mo. Our usual 12mo reserved discounts land ~10-15%. For mixed pools + burst we typically add a premium that reduces the discount. Need ARR and total committed spend before agreeing.

hannah: If we consider >15% we need deal desk sign-off + legal special terms. Also: security questionnaire and SOC2 answers must be in the contract. If Saturn wants the 25% ask, we should ask what lifecycle/ARR this would unlock (reference, expansion, etc).

maria: Customer counters: 20% at 12mo or 15% at 24mo + 24/7 support. They're willing to be a reference. They want burst for performance spikes during their model tuning window (first 3 months).

kevin: Ops note: autoscale policy ok but we need to enforce a hard burst cap of 4x H100. Also will require a reserved eviction policy and a runbook. We cannot guarantee H100 availability for bursts during peak market demand unless we pre-allocate a small burst reservation.

maria: Can sales offer a hybrid: 18% discount on baseline for 12mo, explicit burst carveout (billed at 1.6x baseline H100 rate), and an option to convert to a 24mo at 20% if they commit to 24/7 support?

dan: Can you put numbers? quick sketch.

ajay: Quick calc (rough):
```
baseline_A100_rate = $0.60/hour
baseline_slots = 8
hours/month = 730
monthly_before_discount = 8 * 730 * 0.60 = $3,504
with_18pct_discount = $3,504 * (1 - 0.18) = $2,873.28
provisioned_burst_fee_estimate = ~$575/month (reserve + occasional consumption)
approx_total_monthly_commit = $2,873.28 + $575 = ~$3,448.28
annual_commit ~ $41,379
```

ajay: If Saturn is strategic and likely to expand, 18% with the conditions above is defensible. 20% at 12mo pushes margin too low without stronger upfront payment or swap to 24mo.

hannah: For approval flow: I'll need a deal-desk ticket, the exact SOW language for burst carveout, and a named SLT (support) add-on if they want 24/7. I can sign off on 18% with: (1) burst cap 4x H100, (2) 90-day review, (3) legal clause for capacity fallback and credits.

maria: Customer: "we need predictable spend during tuning window, otherwise we can't commit." I'll ask if they accept the 18% + 4x H100 hard cap + 90-day review + 24/7 support add-on option to go to 20% at 24mo.

dealbot: deal-desk ticket created: DD-4567 (SaturnAI — POC commit pricing request). Attachments: initial quote draft.

kevin: Ops request for ticket: include expected start date, time windows for high-burst tests, and a fallback model variant if H100 unavailable. Also include required KMS key id for private deploys if they go private.

zoe: I'll own the POC runbook and will send infra schedule. I'll include the automated rollback trigger and test checklist.

dan: Asking for final: anyone object to approving 18% discount limited to the initial 12mo with conditions (burst carveout, capacity cap, 90-day review, support add-on)? We need deal-desk sign-off by EOD to hit customer's procurement timeline. @hannah please approve if ok.

hannah: Approve DD-4567 with listed constraints and legal to draft special terms. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all — I'll present 18% + burst carveout to Saturn and loop back with their response.

kevin: FYI ops will stage capacity once legal has the SOW.

zoe: Adding a note to POC checklist to instrument token-level cost metrics so customer can see cost impact of burst tests.

maria: Closing for now — will update thread when Saturn responds. :rocket:
